prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat pyproject.toml; git ls-files; mypy 2>&1 | tail -40
cd src/trailhead; cat -n elevation.py pace.py report.py track.py; grep -n "ele\|None" plan.py cli.py geo.py; cd ../..; grep -rn "None\|ele" tests | head -60; cat README.md
cat src/trailhead/cli.py src/trailhead/plan.py tests/conftest.py; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; ruff check 2>&1 | tail -3

python - <<'EOF'
import re
from pathlib import Path
d = Path("src/trailhead")
t = d/"track.py"
s = t.read_text()
old = '''    def length_km(self) -> float:
        return sum(self.leg_lengths_km())
'''
new = old + '''
    def elevations(self) -> list[float]:
        """Elevation of every point in metres, with the missing ones filled in.

        A point without an elevation takes that of the nearest earlier point that
        has one or, if there is none, of the nearest later point. A track with no
        elevations at all is treated as flat at 0 m.
        """
        first = next((p.ele for p in self.points if p.ele is not None), 0.0)
        filled: list[float] = []
        for point in self.points:
            filled.append(point.ele if point.ele is not None else filled[-1] if filled else first)
        return filled
'''
assert old in s
t.write_text(s.replace(old, new))

def sub(name, pairs):
    p = d/name; s = p.read_text()
    for a, b in pairs:
        assert a in s, a
        s = s.replace(a, b)
    p.write_text(s)

sub("elevation.py", [
 ("    elevations = [point.ele for point in track.points]\n", "    elevations = track.elevations()\n"),
 ("    for (a, b), km in zip(pairwise(track.points), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True):",
  "    for (a, b), km in zip(pairwise(track.elevations()), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True):"),
 ("abs(b.ele - a.ele)", "abs(b - a)"),
])
sub("pace.py", [("counted_changes([p.ele for p in track.points])", "counted_changes(track.elevations())")])
sub("report.py", [("gain_and_loss([point.ele for point in track.points], threshold)", "gain_and_loss(track.elevations(), threshold)")])
EOF
